native_CLI.output: Preserve the accepted CO2 109-state/44-ledger/6-event-total/17-balance stored rows, forcing_step_index, original units and microsecond UTC. The committed v2 journal retains management before/after state and derived quantities but excludes transient after_rhs; do not manufacture Solar/CO2 per-event RHS diagnostics or perform read calculations. A ppm value needs the explicit wet/dry basis: require the stored source_program matched to manifest.program_sha256, select basis by the original stored forcing_step_index (not latest forcing at the same UTC, which can be unconfirmed on hold), and expose only basis metadata, not raw boundary parameters/forcing. The trusted current reader later supplies its existing reader._context[program] in the same read session; projection alone does not authorize or authenticate pages. Versioned new family and finite/closed schemas, body limits, privacy and actual original/fresh/SCRAM tests are required before acceptance.

test_budget_review.output: The exception chain reaches psycopg AdminShutdown during registration after the owned RSS guard requests SIGTERM. This is a resource-stopped test, not evidence of a projection arithmetic defect. An owned PostgreSQL probe confirms PGOPTIONS work_mem=64kB/jit=off is replaced by the explicit runtime-style options value, leaving work_mem=4MB/jit=on. Apply the same intended work_mem/jit settings at startup only for the new projection test database, and assert them on an actual runtime SCRAM connection. Keep production code, shared fixtures, SQL/rights checks, all original test cases/data/steps/timeouts, 512 MiB/PID and combined 1 GiB including five protected roots unchanged. Do not attribute the whole peak to JIT without a query-level measurement; the resource fix is a test budget configuration correction.

dependency_review.output: The closed projection contract and actual SCRAM normal/hold plus two original-wire fresh readers are now verified. This is sufficient to start developing the same-session current query. Preserve the original combined WSL capacity criterion as an unchecked child and a prerequisite for user activation; do not call the whole projection parent, end-to-end G1, deployment or any agricultural/economic gate complete. This separates development dependency from runtime release acceptance without removing either requirement.
